jsonSchema.title: Redfish Service Discovery
jsonSchema.description: Discovers Redfish ServiceRoot endpoints in explicitly configured networks.

discoverer.title: Discoverer
discoverer.description: What to scan and how to connect to what is found.

redfish.title: Redfish
redfish.description: Settings of the Redfish endpoint scanner.

rescan_interval.title: Rescan interval
rescan_interval.description: How often to scan. Set to 0 for one scan per discoverer start.

device_cache_ttl.title: Endpoint cache TTL
device_cache_ttl.description: How long a validated endpoint remains trusted. Set to 0 for no age expiry.

max_concurrent_scans.title: Concurrent scans
max_concurrent_scans.description: Maximum number of addresses probed at the same time across all networks.

profiles.title: Connection profiles
profiles.description: Named sets of connection settings that networks reference by name, and that the generated jobs inherit. At least one is required.

name.title: Name
name.description: Identifies this profile so a network can reference it. It does not become the name of the generated job.

scheme.title: Scheme
scheme.description: Scheme used to reach the Redfish service on the discovered addresses.

node_mode.title: Node mode
node_mode.description: Where the charts of the generated jobs appear: `local` publishes them on the collecting node, `system_vnodes` creates one virtual node per ComputerSystem.

vnode.title: Virtual Node
vnode.description: Associates the generated jobs with a [Virtual Node](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/configuration/organize-systems-metrics-and-alerts#virtual-nodes). Used only when the node mode is `local`.

auth_method.title: Authentication method
auth_method.description: How the generated jobs authenticate with the BMC. `auto` prefers a Redfish session and falls back to HTTP basic authentication.

username.title: Username
username.description: Username of the BMC account. Required unless the authentication method is `none`. Discovery never sends it; it is only passed to the generated jobs.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password of the BMC account. Required unless the authentication method is `none`. Discovery never sends it; it is only passed to the generated jobs.

autodetection_retry.title: Detection retry
autodetection_retry.description: How often a generated job retries the initial connection when it fails to start, in seconds. Zero disables retries.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: HTTP request timeout, in seconds. It applies to the discovery probe and to the generated jobs.

retries.title: GET retries
retries.description: Number of extra attempts for a request that fails with a transient error.

max_concurrent_requests.title: Maximum concurrent requests
max_concurrent_requests.description: Maximum number of requests a generated job sends to one BMC at the same time. Lower it for controllers that rate-limit.

proxy_url.title: Proxy URL
proxy_url.description: Proxy to use for the BMC requests. It applies to the discovery probe and to the generated jobs. Leave empty to use the proxy settings from the environment.

tls_ca.title: TLS CA
tls_ca.description: Path to a CA bundle file used to verify the BMC certificate. Leave empty to use the system trust store.

tls_cert.title: TLS client certificate
tls_cert.description: Path to a client certificate file for mutual TLS. Requires a client key. Used only by the generated jobs, never by the discovery probe.

tls_key.title: TLS client key
tls_key.description: Path to the client key file for mutual TLS. Requires a client certificate. Used only by the generated jobs, never by the discovery probe.

tls_skip_verify.title: Skip TLS verification
tls_skip_verify.description: Accept any certificate the BMC presents, including self-signed and expired ones.

collect.title: Collection families
collect.description: Simple pattern selecting which component families the generated jobs collect: base, compute, memory, thermal, power, storage, network, pcie, sensors, and firmware. Base is always collected.

charts.title: Charts
charts.description: Controls how many charts the generated jobs create.

aggregates.title: Aggregate charts
aggregates.description: Create one summary chart per component family, in addition to any detailed charts.

details.title: Detailed component charts
details.description: Create one chart per individual component, such as each fan, sensor, or drive.

max_detailed_components_per_family.title: Detailed component cap
max_detailed_components_per_family.description: Maximum number of components charted per family and per owner. Zero removes the limit.

alarms.title: Alarms
alarms.description: Controls how the health of a component is decided.

evaluate_thresholds.title: Evaluate source thresholds
evaluate_thresholds.description: Compare readings against the warning and critical thresholds the BMC reports, for components where the BMC reports no health state of its own. A health state reported by the BMC always wins.

logs.title: LogService
logs.description: Controls collection of the Redfish LogService entries.

enabled.title: Enable LogService polling
enabled.description: Collect LogService entries. Collection runs only while the selected log backend is ready.

backend.title: Log backend
backend.description: Name of the `redfish_logs` job that stores the entries. Leave empty to use the job named `default`; a name that does not exist never falls back.

service_selector.title: LogService selector
service_selector.description: Simple pattern selecting which of the discovered LogServices to collect.

max_services.title: Maximum selected LogServices
max_services.description: Maximum number of LogServices collected from one endpoint.

full_reconciliation_every.title: Full reconciliation interval
full_reconciliation_every.description: How often to re-read every selected LogService from the start, in seconds. Zero disables it.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Controls how the read positions of the LogServices are retained.

orphan_retention.title: Orphan cursor retention
orphan_retention.description: How long to keep the read position of a LogService that is no longer collected, in seconds. Zero keeps it forever.

update_every.title: Update every
update_every.description: Data collection interval of the generated jobs, in seconds. The same interval paces endpoint metrics and LogService polling.

networks.title: Networks
networks.description: Address ranges to scan, each with the ports to try and the profile to use. At least one is required.

subnet.title: Subnet
subnet.description: IPv4 or IPv6 range in CIDR notation, or a single address. Where ranges overlap, the most specific one wins.

ports.title: Ports
ports.description: TCP ports to try on every address in this range.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Name of the connection profile to use for this range, as defined on the Connection profiles list.

services.title: Service rules
services.description: Rules that turn a discovered Redfish endpoint into a data collection job.

id.title: Rule ID
id.description: Identifies this rule in the logs, so you can tell which rule matched an endpoint.

match.title: Match expression
match.description: Go template expression that must evaluate to `true` for this rule to apply to a discovered endpoint.

config_template.title: Config template
config_template.description: Go template that produces the job configuration in YAML. It must set the module and a unique job name.
